statement: New research minigame jelly operator added and unlocked via research grid upgrade
Speak to the jelly in the jellofish map to play jelly operator
Research upgrade gives more blood cells from operations; blood cells appear to be the currency
Research upgrade daily operating procedure gives plus one operation at the start of every day
Cellular warfare research upgrade multiplies all cell damage dealt during operations
Unlock eight cell types and buy 37 upgrades with blood cells earned during operations
72 obstructions to remove each giving a bonus affecting the rest of the game; similar to sushi
Mossy green palette bonus now works and boosts all cell damage in jelly operator
Palette bonuses do not need to be selected; they are always active
New atom unlocks from one of the jelly operator obstruction bonuses
New tome metric for successful jelly operations with 800 points at max
If close to next tome breakpoint (even 800 away) push it now to snipe next tier and get a tag; tome sniping is the meta
Season 5 of grand tournament starts later today; season 4 rewards given out
Tournament rewards include three new hats across tier two and three
New tournament hats count toward slab but do not go in the hat rack
New sushi added making 64 unique pieces of sushi
Organelle cell in jelly operator boosts adjacent cell speed by a multiplier; end of sushi boosts the new mechanic
New champion pets bronze silver and gold earls added
Claim the freebie in the new limited time gem shop section
Freebie gives plus one operation today; it still costs one gem
Emerald bling pendant: 100% prioritize; best in slot with nothing close; critical for coin farming
Returning FOMO drop rate keychains beat dungeon ones and are best in slot but not necessary in current meta
Equinox penguins are FOMO for equinox bar fill rate
Order: bling pendant then equinox penguins then key chains then maybe overalls then hat then codifiers
Codifiers and hat are whatever you want
New bundle includes 10x farming stick of fine chance; probably just okay
Stick bundle is good only if you lack doggo sticker which gives effectively infinite stickers
Account bonus bundle 2x currency for minehead and sushi; not necessary since not gated on sushi and minehead stays slow
The new minigame part of bundle is necessary if you want to get ahead
Dead bones name tag is the only one missing that sends his account over the edge; sold in a pack with one tag
Stones added to the middle of the summoning upgrade board; purely visual
Sushi combo high scores reset due to balance changes
Salt shaker no longer counts for sushi combo to stop stockpiling salt via spam clicking instead of real combining
He agrees with the change; spam clicking salt was clearly best and what he did from day one
Royal Guardian commander rank now gives a new unit every rank from rank one instead of from rank four
Rank EXP to rank up increased slightly retroactively so higher ranks are not arbitrarily ahead
He doubts the rank EXP increase fixes the intended problem
Fixed lag when gaining huge amounts of EXP
Fixed lag when opening summoning upgrade menu
Fixed negative nova dust bug affecting top endgamers
Fixed bug where crystal mob spawn chance multiplier for cards got mixed with other aspect bonuses
Genie and poop cards had changed from multiplier to additive; community assumed a shadow change
Community ran demon genie in one slot plus a drop rate multiplier card in other; was better for xeno farming at coral cave crab
Since the card change was a bug the earlier testing and setups should be reverted
Fixed bug where mob will drop chance for royal garden became lower after 100 drops in certain cases
Unclear whether mob will drops were fully reverted or a shadow change was fixed; needs testing
